properties.name: spring.pipedtemplate.prefix
properties.description: Prefix path for template resolution (defaults to classpath:/pte-templates/).

properties.name: spring.pipedtemplate.suffix
properties.description: Suffix extension for template resolution (defaults to .pte).

properties.name: spring.pipedtemplate.order
properties.description: View resolver order for Spring MVC.

properties.name: spring.pipedtemplate.routing.fail-fast
properties.description: Whether route discovery errors cause application startup to fail.

properties.name: spring.pipedtemplate.pwa.registration-mode
properties.description: PWA service worker registration mode (external or inline).

properties.name: spring.pipedtemplate.pwa.registration-script
properties.description: Custom registration script URL for external mode.

properties.name: spring.pipedtemplate.pwa.require-nonce-for-inline
properties.description: Whether inline PWA registration script tags require a nonce attribute.
